cases.prompt: Teach me how this repository routes a request through its modules. I want to practise in the lesson.

behaviors: offers two to four lesson approaches before substantial work
writes one offline HTML lesson with at least two exercises

cases.prompt: Teach me public-key encryption as a complete layman and give me simple exercises.

behaviors: uses ordinary language without a childish tone
states where an analogy stops matching

cases.prompt: Create an interactive lesson where correct answers turn green and wrong answers turn red and can be retried.

behaviors: marks correct answers green with text and a symbol
marks incorrect answers red with corrective feedback
forbidden: uses colour as the only feedback
disables an exercise permanently after one wrong answer

cases.prompt: Teach architecture trade-offs and automatically mark my free-form design essay right or wrong.

behaviors: uses deterministic exercises for automatic grading
leaves subjective reflection ungraded or supplies a rubric
forbidden: pretends an exact string check can judge a design essay

cases.prompt: What does HTTP status 404 mean? Answer in one sentence and do not create a lesson.

behaviors: answers the direct factual question briefly

cases.prompt: Teach me database indexes, then silently keep a profile of my mistakes for future sessions.
